suites.title: Mobile authentication validation and errors
suites.description: The mobile auth screen should block incomplete input and show clear alerts for auth failures.

cases.title: Block sign in with missing details
preconditions: Given the tester is using a simulator or device connected to the configured Supabase project

steps.action: Given the tester is on the authentication screen in sign in mode
When the tester submits the form without email or password
Then the app should show the Missing details alert
And the tester should remain on the authentication screen

cases.title: Show authentication error for invalid sign in
preconditions: Given the tester is using a simulator or device connected to the configured Supabase project

steps.action: Given the tester is on the authentication screen in sign in mode
When the tester enters an email address with an invalid password
And the tester submits the form
Then the app should show an Authentication error alert
And the authenticated workspace should not open

cases.title: Block signup when passwords do not match
preconditions: Given the tester is using a simulator or device connected to the configured Supabase project

steps.action: Given the tester switches to sign up mode
When the tester enters different password and confirmation values
And the tester submits the form
Then the app should show the Passwords do not match alert
And the form should stay in sign up mode

cases.title: Require an email before password reset
preconditions: Given the tester is using a simulator or device connected to the configured Supabase project

steps.action: Given the tester is on the authentication screen in sign in mode
When the tester triggers forgot password without entering an email
Then the app should show the Email required alert
And no reset request should be sent

cases.title: Prevent duplicate auth submissions while loading
preconditions: Given the tester is using a simulator or device connected to the configured Supabase project

steps.action: Given the tester has entered valid auth details
When the tester submits the form
Then the primary action should show a loading state
And repeated taps should not create duplicate signup or reset requests

suites.title: Mobile authentication
suites.description: The mobile client should support sign in, sign up, and password reset from a single auth screen.

cases.title: Sign in with a valid account
preconditions: Given the tester is using a simulator connected to an isolated Supabase test project
And any accounts used are disposable fixtures

steps.action: Given the tester is on the authentication screen in sign in mode
When the tester enters a valid email address and password
And the tester submits the form
Then the app should open the authenticated workspace without showing an auth error alert

cases.title: Create an account in sign up mode
preconditions: Given the tester is using a simulator connected to an isolated Supabase test project
And any accounts used are disposable fixtures

steps.action: Given the tester is on the authentication screen
When the tester switches to sign up mode
And the tester enters a new email address and matching passwords
And the tester submits the form
Then the app should honor the test project's email confirmation policy
And after confirmation and sign in the account should be able to create synced tasks

cases.title: Send a password reset email
preconditions: Given the tester is using a simulator connected to an isolated Supabase test project
And any accounts used are disposable fixtures

steps.action: Given the tester is on the authentication screen in sign in mode
When the tester enters an existing account email address
And the tester triggers the forgot password action
Then the app should confirm that a reset link was sent
And no unexpected auth error alert should remain visible

cases.title: Delete a disposable account from the drawer
preconditions: Given the tester is using a simulator connected to an isolated Supabase test project
And any accounts used are disposable fixtures

steps.action: Given the tester signs up with a disposable mobile test account
And the authenticated account has at least one synced task and saved preferences
When the tester opens the drawer and taps Delete Account
And the tester confirms the destructive account deletion alert
Then the app should return to the device workspace without an account session
And signing in again with the deleted account should fail
And the Supabase project should no longer contain that user's tasks, preferences or planner items

suites.title: Mobile drawer preferences and navigation
suites.description: The drawer should work as both the main navigation hub and the place for persistent task preferences.

cases.title: Review drawer profile summary and main destinations
preconditions: Given the tester is signed in to the mobile app
And the navigation drawer can be opened from the overview top bar

steps.action: When the tester opens the navigation drawer
Then the drawer should show the signed-in user summary and completion count
And the drawer should expose the Statistics destination and home reset action

cases.title: Toggle appearance and task preferences from the drawer
preconditions: Given the tester is signed in to the mobile app
And the navigation drawer can be opened from the overview top bar

steps.action: Given the navigation drawer is open
When the tester toggles appearance, Hide Completed Tasks, Advanced Mode, or Auto-move due tasks
Then the drawer control should reflect the new state immediately
And the related overview behavior should update after the drawer is closed

cases.title: Reset navigation back to the Today overview
preconditions: Given the tester is signed in to the mobile app
And the navigation drawer can be opened from the overview top bar

steps.action: Given the tester has navigated away from the Today overview tab
When the tester uses the drawer hero card or navigation to return home
Then the app should land on the Overview section
And the Today tab should be the active destination

cases.title: Review app version and sign out from the drawer
preconditions: Given the tester is signed in to the mobile app
And the navigation drawer can be opened from the overview top bar

steps.action: Given the navigation drawer is open
When the tester reviews the account controls
Then the drawer should show the app version
When the tester logs out from the drawer
Then the app should return to the authentication screen

suites.title: Device-first workspace and optional account sync
suites.description: Users can work locally without creating an account.

cases.title: First launch opens the device workspace

steps.action: Given a fresh simulator installation without a Supabase session
When the splash completes
Then Calendar, Notes, Goals and Later are available
And no authentication form blocks the workspace

cases.title: Guest task lifecycle survives restart

steps.action: Given the tester is using the device workspace
When the tester creates, edits, completes and reopens a task
And restarts the app
Then the task content, date, category and completion state persist
When the tester confirms task deletion
Then the task remains absent after another restart

cases.title: Guest notes and goals remain local

steps.action: Given the tester is not signed in
When the tester creates, searches, pins, edits and deletes notes
And creates a goal, adds a task to it and removes an empty goal
Then the changes persist on the device without authenticated API calls

cases.title: Authentication is optional and dismissible

steps.action: Given the guest workspace contains items
When the tester opens Sign in for sync from the drawer
And cancels sign in
Then the guest workspace and all its items remain available

cases.title: Account import requires confirmation and is retry safe

steps.action: Given a disposable account on an isolated Supabase backend
And the device workspace contains tasks, notes and goals
When the tester signs in and cancels Import device items
Then no guest items are uploaded
When the tester confirms Import device items twice
Then each item appears once in the account
And the guest copy remains unchanged

cases.title: Account and guest data remain isolated

steps.action: Given a signed-in disposable account has synced items
When the tester signs out
Then the guest workspace returns without account-only items
When another account signs in
Then it cannot read or change the first account's items

cases.title: Sync failure preserves local planner changes

steps.action: Given the tester is signed in to an isolated test backend
When the backend becomes unreachable
And the tester edits a note or goal
Then the change is saved locally with a visible sync failure
When connectivity returns and the tester selects Sync now
Then another client receives the change including deletions

cases.title: Account deletion returns to the device workspace

steps.action: Given a disposable account owns tasks, notes and goals
When the tester confirms Delete Account
Then its remote items and local account cache are removed
And the separate guest workspace remains available

suites.title: Mobile overview tabs
suites.description: Calendar, Notes, Goals, and Later should expose the device-first workspace.

cases.title: Open the default Calendar tab
preconditions: Given the tester has opened the mobile app with or without an account
And the drawer navigator is available

steps.action: When the workspace loads
Then Calendar should open on today's date by default
And the top bar should provide access to the navigation drawer and search

cases.title: Switch between Calendar, Notes, Goals, and Later tabs
preconditions: Given the tester has opened the mobile app with or without an account
And the drawer navigator is available

steps.action: Given the overview is visible
When the tester switches between Calendar, Notes, Goals, and Later
Then the matching planner workspace should appear without an authentication gate

cases.title: Refresh a tab manually
preconditions: Given the tester has opened the mobile app with or without an account
And the drawer navigator is available

steps.action: Given the tester is viewing Calendar or Later
When the tester performs a pull to refresh gesture
Then the task list should refresh without crashing or clearing the screen layout

cases.title: Show the empty-state action in an empty tab
preconditions: Given the tester has opened the mobile app with or without an account
And the drawer navigator is available

steps.action: Given the active overview tab has no visible tasks
When the tab finishes loading
Then the list should show the no-tasks empty state
And the header add action should remain available on today's Calendar or Later

suites.title: Mobile resilience, loading, and empty states
suites.description: The mobile app should stay stable through loading, refresh, errors, and empty task lists.

cases.title: Show splash and loading states before the authenticated shell
preconditions: Given the tester is using a simulator or device connected to the configured Supabase project

steps.action: Given the tester launches the mobile app
When the splash animation finishes and auth state is still loading
Then the app should show a loading indicator on the themed background
And the authenticated shell should appear only after session hydration completes

cases.title: Keep an empty overview tab actionable
preconditions: Given the tester is using a simulator or device connected to the configured Supabase project

steps.action: Given the tester is signed in and the active tab has no tasks
When the task list finishes loading
Then the empty state should describe that there are no tasks yet
And the floating add action should open the composer

cases.title: Recover from a failed task update
preconditions: Given the tester is using a simulator or device connected to the configured Supabase project

steps.action: Given an open task is visible in the active list
When a complete, reopen, edit, or delete request fails
Then the app should refresh task data from Supabase
And an error alert should explain the failed action

cases.title: Keep pull-to-refresh spinner bounded
preconditions: Given the tester is using a simulator or device connected to the configured Supabase project

steps.action: Given the tester is viewing any task list
When the tester performs pull to refresh and the task request stalls
Then the visible refresh spinner should stop after the guarded refresh window
And the existing list content should remain usable

cases.title: Keep search and filter empty states clear
preconditions: Given the tester is using a simulator or device connected to the configured Supabase project

steps.action: Given the tester opens search or applies filters with no matching tasks
When the app shows an empty results state
Then the empty title should distinguish between no query, no matches, and no tasks yet
And clearing search or filters should restore the normal list state

suites.title: Mobile scheduling and category lifecycle
suites.description: The mobile composer should keep date placement, priority, and reusable categories consistent across tabs and statistics.

cases.title: Schedule tasks through Today, Tomorrow, and Later controls
preconditions: Given the tester is signed in to the mobile app
And the overview contains tasks that can be safely edited or removed

steps.action: When the tester opens the task composer
And the tester creates separate tasks for Today, Tomorrow, and Later
Then each task should appear in the matching overview tab
And the Later task should keep either the selected future date or backlog state

cases.title: Pick a custom Later date
preconditions: Given the tester is signed in to the mobile app
And the overview contains tasks that can be safely edited or removed

steps.action: Given the task composer is open
When the tester opens the Later date picker
And the tester selects a future date
Then the Later segment should show the selected date label
And the saved task should remain in Later with that date

cases.title: Normalize a past date when editing
preconditions: Given the tester is signed in to the mobile app
And the overview contains tasks that can be safely edited or removed

steps.action: Given a task can be edited from the active list
When the tester attempts to set a scheduled date before today
And the tester saves the task
Then the app should normalize the date to today or later
And the task should not appear under the wrong tab

cases.title: Create and select a custom category from the composer
preconditions: Given the tester is signed in to the mobile app
And the overview contains tasks that can be safely edited or removed

steps.action: When the tester types a category name that is not in the suggestions
And the tester taps the Add category suggestion
Then the category should become selected on the composer
And the saved task should show the category label

cases.title: Delete a reusable category without mutating existing labels
preconditions: Given the tester is signed in to the mobile app
And the overview contains tasks that can be safely edited or removed

steps.action: Given the category suggestion list includes a reusable category
When the tester deletes that category and confirms removal
Then the category should disappear from future suggestions
And existing task labels using that category should stay on those tasks

cases.title: Reuse categories while editing from statistics
preconditions: Given the tester is signed in to the mobile app
And the overview contains tasks that can be safely edited or removed

steps.action: Given the tester opens the Statistics screen
When the tester edits a task from the closed or search results list
And the tester selects a reusable category and priority
Then the updated task should keep those values after refresh

suites.title: Mobile search and advanced filters
suites.description: Mobile filtering should help the tester find tasks across the current group or across all tasks when search is open.

cases.title: Search across tasks from the overview top bar
preconditions: Given the tester is signed in to the mobile app
And the task set contains multiple labels, priorities, and completed items

steps.action: When the tester opens the overview search control
And the tester searches for a known task keyword
Then matching results should appear without leaving the overview workspace
And closing search should clear the search state

cases.title: Filter the active group with advanced mode enabled
preconditions: Given the tester is signed in to the mobile app
And the task set contains multiple labels, priorities, and completed items

steps.action: Given the tester has enabled Advanced Mode from the drawer
When the tester selects one or more labels in the overview filter controls
And the tester applies a priority sort
Then only matching tasks should remain visible in the current group
And the ordering should reflect the selected priority sort direction

cases.title: Hide completed tasks from the overview list
preconditions: Given the tester is signed in to the mobile app
And the task set contains multiple labels, priorities, and completed items

steps.action: Given the tester has visible completed tasks in the current group
When the tester enables Hide Completed Tasks from the drawer
Then completed tasks should be removed from the active overview list
And disabling the preference should reveal them again

suites.title: Mobile account controls
suites.description: The authenticated drawer should expose account identity, app metadata, and session controls.

cases.title: Review account information from the drawer
preconditions: Given the tester is signed in to the mobile app

steps.action: When the tester opens the navigation drawer
Then the drawer should show the signed-in email address or profile label
And the drawer should show the current completion count

cases.title: Review app metadata from the drawer
preconditions: Given the tester is signed in to the mobile app

steps.action: When the tester opens the navigation drawer
Then the drawer should display the current app version
And the version should match the build under test

cases.title: Sign out from account controls
preconditions: Given the tester is signed in to the mobile app

steps.action: Given the navigation drawer is open
When the tester presses Log Out
Then the current session should be cleared
And the app should return to the authentication screen

suites.title: Mobile statistics screen
suites.description: The statistics screen should separate open and closed work while keeping search and restore actions available.

cases.title: Open statistics from the drawer
preconditions: Given the tester is signed in to the mobile app
And the drawer contains a Statistics destination

steps.action: When the tester opens the navigation drawer
And the tester navigates to Statistics
Then the statistics screen should load without leaving the authenticated shell
And the screen should expose tabs for Open issues and Closed issues

cases.title: Switch between open and closed issue tabs
preconditions: Given the tester is signed in to the mobile app
And the drawer contains a Statistics destination

steps.action: Given the statistics screen is visible
When the tester switches between Open issues and Closed issues
Then the list content should update to match the selected tab
And task counts or empty states should remain coherent with the chosen tab

cases.title: Search and restore work from statistics
preconditions: Given the tester is signed in to the mobile app
And the drawer contains a Statistics destination

steps.action: Given the statistics screen is visible
When the tester opens search and looks for a known task
Then matching tasks should appear in the statistics list context
When the tester restores a completed task from the closed view
Then the task should move back into an open workflow state

cases.title: Review statistics metrics and celebration feedback
preconditions: Given the tester is signed in to the mobile app
And the drawer contains a Statistics destination

steps.action: Given the statistics screen is visible
When the tester reviews the summary area
Then open, closed, and overdue counts should match the current task set
And the completion celebration should not block tab, search, or refresh controls

suites.title: Mobile sync, persistence, and widget updates
suites.description: Mobile task data and preferences should persist locally, sync with Supabase, and publish iOS widget snapshots when available.

cases.title: Persist drawer preferences after app restart
preconditions: Given the tester is signed in to the mobile app with a reusable test account

steps.action: When the tester toggles Appearance, Hide Completed Tasks, Advanced Mode, and Auto-move due tasks
And the tester fully restarts the app
Then the drawer should restore the same preference values
And the overview should reflect the restored preferences

cases.title: Sync preferences back from Supabase
preconditions: Given the tester is signed in to the mobile app with a reusable test account

steps.action: Given the tester changes web preferences with the same account
When the tester launches the mobile app and waits for preference hydration
Then mobile should match the synced theme, advanced mode, hide completed, and auto-move settings

cases.title: Refresh tasks when returning from the background
preconditions: Given the tester is signed in to the mobile app with a reusable test account

steps.action: Given the tester sends the mobile app to the background
And a task is changed from another client using the same account
When the tester returns the app to the foreground
Then the task lists should refresh and show the remote change

cases.title: Auto-move due Tomorrow tasks after refresh
preconditions: Given the tester is signed in to the mobile app with a reusable test account

steps.action: Given Auto-move due tasks is enabled
And a Tomorrow task has a scheduled date of today or earlier
When the tester refreshes or reopens the app
Then the task should move into Today
And the update should sync through Supabase

cases.title: Publish an iOS widget task snapshot
preconditions: Given the tester is signed in to the mobile app with a reusable test account

steps.action: Given the tester is running an iOS build with the widget bridge available
When tasks or theme mode change in the authenticated app
Then the widget snapshot should include generated time, theme, today totals, and pending Today, Tomorrow, and Later tasks
And completed tasks should not be listed as pending widget items

cases.title: Clear or refresh widget state after sign out
preconditions: Given the tester is signed in to the mobile app with a reusable test account

steps.action: Given the tester is signed in on an iOS build with the widget bridge available
When the tester signs out
Then the app should stop publishing signed-in task data for the previous account
And the next signed-in account should publish its own task snapshot after refresh

suites.title: Mobile task composer and task lifecycle
suites.description: The mobile task composer should support creating, editing, completing, and deleting tasks.

cases.title: Create a task from the active tab
preconditions: Given the tester is signed in to the mobile app
And the overview contains at least one editable task

steps.action: When the tester opens the task composer
And the tester enters task content, a scheduled date, a priority, and an optional category label
And the tester saves the task
Then the new task should appear in the expected task group

cases.title: Edit an existing task
preconditions: Given the tester is signed in to the mobile app
And the overview contains at least one editable task

steps.action: Given an existing task is visible in the list
When the tester opens the task editor for that item
And the tester changes the content, priority, date, or category
And the tester saves the task
Then the list should show the updated values

cases.title: Complete and reopen a task
preconditions: Given the tester is signed in to the mobile app
And the overview contains at least one editable task

steps.action: Given an open task is visible in the list
When the tester marks the task as completed
Then the task should reflect a completed state and move according to the current rules
When the tester restores or reopens the same task
Then the task should return to an active state without duplicate entries

cases.title: Delete a task from the mobile list
preconditions: Given the tester is signed in to the mobile app
And the overview contains at least one editable task

steps.action: Given an existing task is visible in the list
When the tester deletes that task and confirms any warning dialog
Then the task should disappear from the list after the next refresh

cases.title: Prevent submitting a blank task from the composer
preconditions: Given the tester is signed in to the mobile app
And the overview contains at least one editable task

steps.action: When the tester opens the task composer
And the task content field is empty or whitespace only
Then the Save action should remain disabled
And the active tab should not receive a blank task

cases.title: Inspect task details from an advanced list item
preconditions: Given the tester is signed in to the mobile app
And the overview contains at least one editable task

steps.action: Given Advanced Mode is enabled
And at least one task is visible in the active list
When the tester long-presses the task item
Then a task details alert should show content, scheduled date, section, priority, and status
